subject: APAC runbook: compacted demo window & facilitator handback request
messages:
From: Rohit Agarwal <rohit@stratussi.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: APAC runbook: compacted demo window & facilitator handback request

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Stratus is lined up to present to a joint APAC prospect on June 10 but our SI asked whether we can compress the runbook into a tighter 45–50 minute window to accommodate local attendees and internal overlap.

Quick asks:
- Can Redwood accommodate a compacted run (45–50m) while keeping the interactive Q&A?
- If yes, would Redwood be able to handback facilitator duties to our SI (Nora) at the 30m mark so we can take the last segment?

We've attached our proposed runbook (Stratus_Runbook_v1.pptx) and a rough availability grid (APAC_availability.xlsx).

If it's easier, happy to hop on a 20-minute call to triage.

Best,
Rohit Agarwal
Head of Partnerships, Stratus Systems
rohit@stratussi.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Rohit Agarwal <rohit@stratussi.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: APAC runbook: compacted demo window & facilitator handback request

Thanks Rohit — this is doable but there are two constraints from our side:

1) Engineering cover: our primary SE for APAC (Ethan) is only available for a full-hour slot in that week; shrinking to 45m means he'll need a slightly earlier start or a staggered join for the Q&A.
2) Recording & Marketplace listing: if we shorten and split facilitation we should agree on a clear recording cut point (so the marketplace listing has the right start/end and doesn't splice two different presenters).

Proposed options (pick one):
- Option A (preferred): Start 30 minutes earlier UTC to keep Ethan in for the whole session and handback to Nora at t=30. Total run = 50m (30m demo + 20m Q&A).
- Option B: Keep original time, Redwood facilitates first 35m, Stratus takes last 25m; Ethan joins only for the first 35m and drops after. Recording will show two hosts.

If you agree to Option A I'll draft a short run-of-show amendment and loop in Marketplace to confirm the listing note.

Also cc'ing Ben and Kim to flag capacity and any policy notes around facilitator handbacks for Marketplace events.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rohit Agarwal <rohit@stratussi.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: APAC runbook: compacted demo window & facilitator handback request

Quick operational notes from my side:
- Option A is fine if Ethan can shift start by 30m; I'll check with him now. If Ethan can't move, Option B is the safer fallback.
- Marketplace ops require a short blurb (<=100 words) noting multiple facilitators and the time ranges — Kimberly, can you confirm the blurb and whether this needs additional approvals?
- One ask for Stratus: can you confirm the exact minute mark where you want the handback (e.g., 29:00 vs 30:00) so we can timestamp the recording and call it out in the runbook?

Ben Carter
GTMSales, Redwood Inference

From: Nora Li <nora.li@cloudwave.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rohit Agarwal <rohit@stratussi.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: APAC runbook: compacted demo window & facilitator handback request

Thanks team — confirming Option A works for us if Redwood can shift 30m earlier. We propose handback at 30:00 (exact).

Action items:
- Stratus will update Stratus_Runbook_v1.pptx to mark handback slide and send final by EOD Thu (attachment stub: Stratus_Runbook_v1_final.pptx).
- Tessa/Ben: please confirm Ethan's new start time (Ben to follow up).
- Kimberly: sample marketplace blurb below for review (feel free to edit):
  "Hosted by Redwood Inference with co-facilitation by Stratus Systems (Nora Li). Redwood leads the initial demo segment. At 30:00, facilitation is handed to Stratus for customer Q&A and closing."

We'll also upload the final runbook to the shared Drive link you provided.

Thanks,
Nora Li
Cloudwave Systems (SI)
